title: situation.virginia_unionists.title
railroad: the Virginia Unionist's visit of 4 April, which the Secretary of State arranged; the convention's sitting is not modelled, so the meeting comes on its date

gate.none: a meeting with a Unionist delegate about the fort and the convention; no gate topic

citations.at: vol. 1 p. 38 (Fox's memo of April 1861: "The last card was to send for a Union man from the Virginia Convention and say to him that Sumpter would be evacuated at once if the Union people ... would adjourn it")
Part II pp. 102 to 105 (Baldwin, sworn: "No pledge; no undertaking; no offer"), pp. 114 to 116 (Botts, sworn: the offer made), p. 71 (Lewis)
